<title level="1" right="Hazard 6" pfs="">[Angry Dead](/Hazards.aspx?ID=405)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Complex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=30" />
<trait label="Haunt" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=88" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 38

**Complexity** Complex

</column>

The faces of the original dwarven inhabitants of the city appear in the stone and scream in anger.

---

**Stealth**
+18 (expert)

**Disable**
DC 23 [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) (trained) to ritually pray for the dead or DC 25 [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) (trained) to exorcise the spirits' anger; a dwarf succeeds at a DC 22 [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check, asking or ordering the spirits to stand down.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Howl of Agony** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16)) **Trigger** At least two living creatures step on the staircase; **Effect** Dozens of mouths open on the stairs and eastern wall doors of the chamber and howl in anger and misery. Creatures in the area are [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 2 rounds and [frightened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) unless they succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save. Creatures who critically fail are deafened for 1 minute and frightened 3. The haunt then rolls initiative.

---
**Routine**
(1 action) The faces continue to scream, dealing 5d6 sonic damage (DC 26 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save) to all living creatures within 20 feet of the steps. On a critical failure, a creature takes double damage and is deafened for 1 round. Deaf creatures are immune to this effect.

---
**Reset**
The haunt deactivates 1 round after all living creatures leave the area. After 1 hour, the haunt reactivates. If the haunt is disabled by a [dwarf](/Traits.aspx?ID=54) succeeding at a Diplomacy or Intimidate check, the haunt is destroyed.
